evals.prompt: Ho il report di sostenibilità 2024 della mia azienda in PDF. Puoi analizzarlo e dirmi dove siamo rispetto agli standard ESRS?
evals.expected_output: Structured analysis identifying which ESRS standards the report covers, key metrics extracted, gaps flagged, and recommendations.
assertions: Lists specific ESRS disclosure codes (e.g., E1-6, S1-6)
Quantitative metrics are extracted, not fabricated

evals.prompt: I need to build a sustainability report from scratch for a 200-employee manufacturing company in Emilia-Romagna. We've never done ESG reporting before. Where do I start?
evals.expected_output: Enters Socratic consulting mode, asks one question at a time starting with company profile, explains ESRS applicability.
assertions: Asks about company size, sector, and geography first
Does not dump all questions at once
Mentions ESRS/CSRD applicability based on company size
Offers to guide through materiality assessment

evals.prompt: This company claims to be carbon neutral since 2023 but I can only find Scope 1 and 2 data. No Scope 3. Their offset portfolio is mostly forestry credits. Red flags?
evals.expected_output: Critical greenwashing analysis identifying missing Scope 3, over-reliance on offsets, and lack of reduction-first approach.
assertions: Flags missing Scope 3 as a critical gap (typically 70-90% of total)
Questions the carbon neutral claim without Scope 3
References EU Green Claims Directive implications
